our_interpretation: The claim concerns capacity Zitron identified in his research, not an unconditional ceiling on worldwide deliveries.
The two-year observation period runs backward from the post date: May 12, 2024 through May 12, 2026.
Delivered means completed and operating capacity, consistent with the surrounding discussion. Announcements and planned campus capacity do not qualify.
A few hundred means several hundred megawatts; the wording does not justify choosing a precise numerical cutoff.
criteria.support_condition: An independently checkable record of the projects he identified, with commissioning dates and comparable capacity measurements, totals only several hundred megawatts within the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An independently checkable record establishes that his research identified substantially more than several hundred megawatts of qualifying delivered capacity. A larger market-wide total alone does not contradict the personal research claim.
